name: @pipeworx/mcp-monday

tools.name: monday_list_boards
tools.description: List all boards in your account. Returns board ID, name, state, and item count to discover available boards.

limit.description: Number of boards to return (default 20, max 50)

tools.name: monday_get_board
tools.description: Get board structure and metadata (e.g., board ID "12345"). Returns name, columns, groups, and item count.

tools.name: monday_list_items
tools.description: List items in a board (e.g., board ID "12345"). Returns item ID, name, group, column values, and created date.

limit.description: Number of items to return (default 20, max 50)

tools.name: monday_create_item
tools.description: Create a new item in a board (e.g., board ID "12345", name "New Task"). Returns created item ID and name.

column_values.description: JSON string of column values to set (e.g., {"status":"Working on it"})

tools.name: monday_search_items
tools.description: Search for items across all boards by keyword. Returns matching items with ID, name, board name, and column values.

limit.description: Number of results to return (default 20, max 50)

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-monday forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the monday pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
